scope: 12,000 inverse E/J outputs; one practical-reconstruction track, not both released and adapter tracks
latent_rng: For each image independently create one CUDA BF16 seed0 latent; repeat identical bytes within each batch. Same initial noise across images/methods is intentional. Observation seeds are separately frozen per image/task.

semantics.reward: negative sum of squared pixel residual A(D(z))-y; no pseudo-inverse-weighted latent loss
semantics.E: At current noise-time sigma, compute separate flow step and clean endpoint. Optimize endpoint with gain eta*(1-sigma)*sigma_next inside every inner update. Add endpoint displacement to the flow step. No additional dt/nopt.
semantics.J: Delegate unchanged inverse-J: current-state endpoint gradient, unit gradient per item rescaled by stepping velocity norm, outer dt. Not generic post-flow Algorithm5.
semantics.grid: Preserve full released shifted scheduler grid; insert E exact sigma0.33 cutoff and finish with separate unguided map to sigma0. Actual grid must match the qualified reference grid.
semantics.nominal_vs_actual_NFE: E nominal100, observed78 transformer invocations; J nominal400, observed400. Record batch invocations and per-image effective invocations separately, plus actual block recomputations and autograd/VAE calls.
semantics.evidence_priority: E.2 practical update wording plus TableE.1 gradient target and released endpoint construction define this explicit convention. Generic Algorithms5/6 order and Eq18 are not asserted equivalent. This is a declared reconstruction, not resolution of an undocumented author implementation.

batching.per_item_loss_reduction: sum over pixels, sum across independent batch items

metrics.primary_per_image: released CLI PNG PSNR and LPIPS VGG with PIL224/ToTensor[0,1], normalize=False
metrics.sensitivity: separate native256 LPIPS VGG on [-1,1]; never mix with CLI LPIPS
metrics.SSIM: pytorch_msssim on PNG ToTensor*255 using pinned defaults
metrics.FID: torchmetrics1.3.2 Inception2048, PIL Resize299/ToTensor*255/uint8; dataset-level only on all1000 IDs
metrics.KID: same features; subset50,100 subsets; reset Torch RNG20261102 for each complete dataset/task/method group
metrics.CI: image-ID bootstrap percentile95%,10000 resamples,NumPy PCG64 seed20261102 for PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS means; no FID CI or equivalence claim
metrics.missing: explicit missing/failed, reject incomplete group scores; no filename intersection or zero fill

execution.extension_beyond_deadline: requires concrete extension; no automatic assumption from flexible wording
execution.batch_retry: no automatic retry of failed/OOM cells; retain attempts
execution.resume: reuse only verified complete cell artifacts with identical contract/cell/runner identities; failed cells require explicit recovery

acceptance: Exact 12,000 unique evaluation cells and 1,000 expected IDs per dataset/task/method; all artifacts and provenance verified. Completion is reconstructed high-NFE E/J evaluation, not all-paper reproduction or headline few-NFE efficacy.
